hsa-combination-excess.zh: 相对最佳单药的额外效应／HSA联合效应
hsa-combination-excess.use_when: 注明最高单药参照、浓度矩阵、评分和读出。
hsa-combination-excess.confusable: HSA不是Bliss或Loewe；一种评分下的效应不能换成另一模型的协同分数。
hsa-combination-excess.safe_example: The combination exceeded the highest-single-agent reference within [tested dose range].
hsa-combination-excess.unsafe_example: An HSA score established clinical synergy and survival benefit.
hsa-combination-excess.boundary: 仅迁移表达结构，不迁移原文分数或临床结论。

growth-versus-regression.zh: 肿瘤生长抑制／基线后退缩／细胞静止／停药后再生长
growth-versus-regression.use_when: 分别写清相对对照的生长抑制、相对基线的体积下降及停药后的生长斜率。
growth-versus-regression.confusable: TGI不等于退缩率；小鼠体积变化不是患者ORR；抑制增殖不等于诱导凋亡。
growth-versus-regression.safe_example: Treatment suppressed growth relative to controls, whereas regression was assessed against each tumor's baseline volume.
growth-versus-regression.unsafe_example: A 95% TGI meant that 95% of patients responded.
growth-versus-regression.boundary: 不同实验的剂量、时间段和统计检验不得混用。

rna-versus-protein-stability.zh: 转录阻断实验／环己酰亚胺追踪／RNA与蛋白稳定性
rna-versus-protein-stability.use_when: 分别描述RNA衰减和蛋白周转，再判断调控发生在哪一层。
rna-versus-protein-stability.confusable: RNA更稳定不等于蛋白半衰期延长；下游底物与上游调控蛋白不是同一检测对象。
rna-versus-protein-stability.safe_example: The transcript difference was linked to RNA stability, while turnover of the downstream protein was assessed separately.
rna-versus-protein-stability.unsafe_example: Increased RNA abundance proved slower degradation of every downstream protein.
rna-versus-protein-stability.boundary: USP36原文试剂浓度、时间和图示存在不一致，不作为直接实验方案。

interaction-versus-affinity.zh: 共免疫沉淀／复合物关联／结合亲和力／泛素拉下
interaction-versus-affinity.use_when: 区分复合物关联、直接结合、蛋白丰度及酶活性。
interaction-versus-affinity.confusable: 共沉淀信号增强可能反映输入量改变；核分离不能直接证明核仁定位。
interaction-versus-affinity.safe_example: Co-immunoprecipitation supported an association between the proteins, with input abundance considered in interpretation.
interaction-versus-affinity.unsafe_example: Stronger co-immunoprecipitation proved higher intrinsic affinity and nucleolar catalytic activity.
interaction-versus-affinity.boundary: 需要独立结合或动力学实验才能加强相应机制断言。

selected-genomic-denominator.zh: 样本级检出率／ctDNA可评价集／条件性突变频率
selected-genomic-denominator.use_when: 注明分母是患者、重复血样、检出阳性样本还是进展时可评价亚组。
selected-genomic-denominator.confusable: 阳性样本中的突变频率不是全体患者患病率；进展时出现不证明新获得。
selected-genomic-denominator.safe_example: Variant frequency was calculated among [explicit evaluable sample set], rather than all enrolled patients.
selected-genomic-denominator.unsafe_example: The proportion in ctDNA-positive progression samples was the prevalence in all patients with lung cancer.
selected-genomic-denominator.boundary: 保留选择条件和重复采样；不能从标题人数直接建立分母。

tissue-plasma-transfer.zh: 组织到血浆的模型迁移／纵向分子监测
tissue-plasma-transfer.use_when: 区分训练、组织验证与血浆测试的分析集和性能。
tissue-plasma-transfer.confusable: 组织AUC不是血浆AUC；总体变异频率相关不是患者配对一致率。
tissue-plasma-transfer.safe_example: Performance was evaluated separately in tissue validation and plasma testing, with eligibility thresholds stated for each dataset.
tissue-plasma-transfer.unsafe_example: Near-perfect tissue discrimination established a validated lung-cancer plasma screening test.
tissue-plasma-transfer.boundary: 小量肺类癌样本不能支持NSCLC专病诊断效能。

informative-negative.zh: 具有解释价值的阴性结果／假阴性风险
informative-negative.use_when: 结合肿瘤分数、检测覆盖和参考检测解释液体活检阴性。
informative-negative.confusable: 阴性不是没有肿瘤；低肿瘤分数下未检出不等于排除驱动改变。
informative-negative.safe_example: No actionable alteration was detected within [assay scope], with interpretation conditioned on [tumor-fraction criterion].
informative-negative.unsafe_example: A negative plasma test ruled out every actionable alteration.
informative-negative.boundary: 保留实际检测范围、配对样本选择和条件分母；不能移植另一平台阈值。

concordance-denominator.zh: 一致性分母／检测失败与不一致
concordance-denominator.use_when: 先定义人、样本、改变层级及可评价范围，再报告一致率。
concordance-denominator.confusable: 双阴性、同一可干预改变、任意共同改变是不同一致性定义；检测失败不是有效阴性。
concordance-denominator.safe_example: Concordance was assessed for [alteration definition] among [paired evaluable specimens], with assay failures reported separately.
concordance-denominator.unsafe_example: All failed tests were valid discordant results.
concordance-denominator.boundary: 组内获益不等于标志物与治疗交互显著；生物异质性不是不一致的唯一原因。

germline-origin.zh: 胚系来源预测与胚系确认
germline-origin.use_when: 区分肿瘤单样本中的来源预测、匹配正常组织确认及遗传风险解释。
germline-origin.confusable: 高VAF不是胚系确认；pathogenic注释不等于已经确认遗传来源。
germline-origin.safe_example: The model estimated germline origin for [eligible variants]; confirmatory testing was considered separately.
germline-origin.unsafe_example: The tumor-only model diagnosed an inherited cancer syndrome.
germline-origin.boundary: 保留变异级与患者级分母，不能把判别能力当作校准或临床效用。

penetrance-versus-age-fraction.zh: 外显率、传递概率与确诊年龄构成
penetrance-versus-age-fraction.use_when: 明确分母是携带者、家系、已确诊肿瘤还是全部随访人时。
penetrance-versus-age-fraction.confusable: 一定年龄前的病例占比不是该年龄前携带者的发病风险；50%遗传传递不是50%患癌。
penetrance-versus-age-fraction.safe_example: Among diagnosed [tumors], [proportion] occurred before [age]; this proportion was not an estimate of penetrance among carriers.
penetrance-versus-age-fraction.unsafe_example: The age distribution of affected probands established population lifetime risk.
penetrance-versus-age-fraction.boundary: 先证者富集、家系聚集与随访差异限制风险估计；早期分期关联不能证明监测降低死亡。

molecular-response-surrogate.zh: 分子反应与替代终点的区别
molecular-response-surrogate.use_when: 报告治疗中ctDNA变化，保留时间点、检测下限和实际纳入配对样本。
molecular-response-surrogate.confusable: 未检出不是所有克隆消失；与生存相关不是已经验证的生存替代终点。
molecular-response-surrogate.safe_example: An on-treatment decline in [ctDNA measure] was associated with [endpoint] in [paired analysis set].
molecular-response-surrogate.unsafe_example: Undetectable ctDNA proved cure and validated a survival surrogate.
molecular-response-surrogate.boundary: 肿瘤分数与单个变异VAF不能混用，重复测量、可采样性及时间依赖偏倚需要考虑。

association.use_when: 报告观察性关联，并保留比较对象、调整状态和不确定性。
association.confusable: association不等于causation；associated with poorer survival不等于reduces survival。
association.safe_example: [Alteration] was associated with [endpoint] after adjustment for [covariates].
association.boundary: 不能从调整后的关联直接推断机制或治疗预测。

knowledge-gap.zh: 尚未充分阐明／仍不明确
knowledge-gap.use_when: 把知识缺口限定到具体人群、机制或分析情境。
knowledge-gap.confusable: limited evidence不等于no evidence；unclear不等于never studied。
knowledge-gap.safe_example: The role of [factor] in [defined setting] remains incompletely characterized.
knowledge-gap.boundary: 首次、唯一、从未等文献断言需额外检索；词句库本身不能证明。

study-objective.zh: 我们评估／研究／旨在阐明
study-objective.use_when: 陈述实际研究问题，不预先写成已证明的结论。
study-objective.confusable: evaluate与validate不同；探索并不等于验证。
study-objective.safe_example: We evaluated the association between [factor] and [endpoint].
study-objective.unsafe_example: We validated the causal role of [factor].
study-objective.boundary: 必须与已实施设计和分析匹配。

analysis-population.zh: 可评价人群／分析集／分母
analysis-population.use_when: 区分入组、治疗、疗效可评价、标志物可评价及配对样本集。
analysis-population.unsafe_example: All enrolled patients contributed to every assay.
analysis-population.boundary: 每个终点单独锁定分母，缺失与剔除需有记录。

co-alteration.zh: 共突变／共改变／共同出现
co-alteration.use_when: 按实际变异类型及条件人群报告共同出现。
co-alteration.safe_example: [Gene A] co-occurred with [gene B] within [genotype-defined population].
co-alteration.unsafe_example: The genes cooperated biologically because they co-occurred.
co-alteration.boundary: 保留KRAS亚型等条件；不要把拷贝数缺失改写为点突变。

variant-function.zh: 功能缺失／致病性／蛋白缺失／等位基因状态
variant-function.use_when: 分别说明序列变异注释、拷贝数与蛋白实验结果。
variant-function.confusable: predicted loss-of-function、biallelic inactivation与IHC蛋白缺失并非同义。
variant-function.safe_example: Variants were classified using [annotation rule]; protein expression was evaluated separately.
variant-function.unsafe_example: Every nonsynonymous mutation abolished protein expression.
variant-function.boundary: 阈值与功能结论不能从另一基因移植。

adjusted-estimate.zh: 调整后／多变量模型／风险比
adjusted-estimate.use_when: 给出效应方向、参照组、协变量及区间。
adjusted-estimate.safe_example: The adjusted HR for [group] versus [reference] was [HR] (95% CI, [lower-upper]).
adjusted-estimate.boundary: 不凭HR数字猜参照方向；区间必须与点估计对应。

null-result.zh: 未达到统计学显著性／区间包含无效值
null-result.use_when: 如实报告未显著结果，同时保留估计值和不确定性。
null-result.confusable: 未显著不等于相同、等效或不存在关联。
null-result.safe_example: The estimate favored [group], but the confidence interval included the null.
null-result.unsafe_example: The treatments were equivalent because P exceeded 0.05.
null-result.boundary: 不要用trend包装失败的显著性检验；等效性需要相应设计。

interaction.zh: 交互作用／治疗效果预测性标志物
interaction.use_when: 区分组内关联与治疗间效果差异。
interaction.confusable: 一组显著另一组不显著，并不证明交互显著。
interaction.safe_example: Whether the association differed by treatment requires a treatment-by-biomarker interaction analysis.
interaction.unsafe_example: The biomarker predicted benefit because only one subgroup had P<0.05.
interaction.boundary: 预后标志物不能自动升级为治疗选择标志物。

endpoint-hierarchy.zh: 主要终点／探索性／事后分析
endpoint-hierarchy.use_when: 完整保留预设性、终点层级和多重比较处理。
endpoint-hierarchy.confusable: 预设次要终点不等于主要终点；事后亚组不等于确证。
endpoint-hierarchy.safe_example: The primary endpoint was not met; [finding] arose from an exploratory analysis.
endpoint-hierarchy.unsafe_example: The trial succeeded because an exploratory subgroup improved.
endpoint-hierarchy.boundary: 摘要与结论不能淡化阴性主要终点。

response-control.zh: 疾病控制／客观缓解／确认缓解
response-control.use_when: 说明缓解标准、确认要求和人群。
response-control.confusable: DCR包含的稳定疾病不能算成ORR；未确认与确认缓解不同。
response-control.safe_example: Disease control and confirmed objective response are reported separately.
response-control.unsafe_example: Disease control rate was the tumor response rate.
response-control.boundary: 中枢与全身终点、病灶与患者分母分别报告。

safety.zh: 不良事件／耐受性／毒性／安全性
safety.use_when: 区分全因与治疗相关、分级、严重事件、停药和死亡。
safety.confusable: serious与severe不同；没有观察到不等于排除风险。
safety.safe_example: [n/N] patients experienced grade [grade] treatment-related adverse events.
safety.unsafe_example: The treatment was safe despite unreported fatal events.
safety.boundary: 不能用manageable替代实际严重毒性数据。

bulk-deconvolution.zh: 反卷积／推断的免疫组成／bulk RNA测序
bulk-deconvolution.use_when: 明确计算推断来自混合组织数据。
bulk-deconvolution.confusable: 推断细胞比例不是单细胞实测比例。
bulk-deconvolution.safe_example: Bulk expression profiles were used to infer [cell signature] using [method].
bulk-deconvolution.unsafe_example: Single-cell sequencing demonstrated the cell proportions.
bulk-deconvolution.boundary: 算法输出不等于独立实验验证。

single-cell-unit.use_when: 保留物种、样本、患者和细胞层级及统计单位。
single-cell-unit.confusable: 细胞数不能当独立患者数；小鼠scRNA不是人类scRNA证据。
single-cell-unit.safe_example: Expression was aggregated by [patient/sample] for pseudobulk analysis.
single-cell-unit.unsafe_example: Thousands of cells represented thousands of independent patients.
single-cell-unit.boundary: 仅在实际使用时陈述伪bulk、批次校正或独立验证。

spatial-assay.use_when: 明确测量的是RNA、蛋白信号还是组织图像。
spatial-assay.confusable: 空间蛋白成像不是空间转录组；空间邻近不是直接相互作用。
spatial-assay.safe_example: Spatial proximity between [cell types] was quantified using [assay].
spatial-assay.unsafe_example: Neighboring cells were proven to signal directly.
spatial-assay.boundary: 共定位、富集、通讯推断与扰动验证分开。

proteomics.zh: 蛋白组学／逆相蛋白阵列／邻近延伸／液相色谱质谱
proteomics.use_when: 报告平台、覆盖、定量方法及QC后分析集合。
proteomics.confusable: 靶向面板、RPPA、流式不能直接叫无偏全蛋白组。
proteomics.safe_example: A targeted [N]-protein panel was analyzed; [n] proteins passed quality control.
proteomics.unsafe_example: A targeted panel comprehensively measured the entire proteome.
proteomics.boundary: label-free与TMT等来源冲突未解决前不能替作者选择。

cell-communication.zh: 细胞通讯推断／配体／受体／信号通路
cell-communication.use_when: 根据实际方法区分表达、评分、通路读出和直接干预。
cell-communication.confusable: 推断通讯不等于分泌实测；通路评分不等于生化活性。
cell-communication.safe_example: The analysis inferred [interaction], which requires experimental confirmation.
cell-communication.unsafe_example: The computation proved secretion and receptor activation.
cell-communication.boundary: 通路激活也不自动证明药物敏感性增加。

validation.zh: 外部验证／独立队列／交叉验证／训练
validation.use_when: 注明患者、中心、时间、拆分、调参及测试隔离。
validation.confusable: 内部随机拆分或交叉验证不是外部验证。
validation.safe_example: Performance was assessed in a held-out internal test set.
validation.unsafe_example: An internal random split established external generalizability.
validation.boundary: 不能因检索到模板就补造验证步骤。

model-performance.zh: 曲线下面积／区分度／临床效用／校准度
model-performance.use_when: 写清预测目标、时间窗、集合和不确定性。
model-performance.confusable: 区分度、校准度及临床效用不同；AUC不是生存C-index的通用替代词。
model-performance.safe_example: The model discriminated [outcome] in [test set], with an AUC of [value].
model-performance.boundary: 可迁移性与临床应用需额外证据。

perturbation.zh: 敲除／敲低／同基因背景／救援实验
perturbation.use_when: 说明模型、对照、扰动、重复和读出。
perturbation.confusable: 非同基因背景细胞系对比不能代替受控扰动；敲低不同于敲除。
perturbation.unsafe_example: Two unrelated cell lines established gene-specific causality.
perturbation.boundary: 机制证据的结论范围限于实际模型与干预。

drug-sensitivity.zh: 半数抑制浓度／药物敏感性／抗肿瘤活性
drug-sensitivity.use_when: 分清药物、浓度、时间、终点、模型与方向。
drug-sensitivity.confusable: IC50升高通常不是敏感性提高；体外活性不是患者获益。
drug-sensitivity.boundary: 来源曲线与正文矛盾时隔离方向性结论。

limitations.zh: 受……限制／局限性／混杂／回顾性
limitations.use_when: 说明具体限制影响哪项推断，而不是套用通用免责声明。
limitations.confusable: 翻译原文时不能默默补上作者未写的限制。
limitations.unsafe_example: All bias was excluded by multivariable adjustment.
limitations.boundary: 翻译正文与新增科学审查意见分开输出。

bounded-conclusion.zh: 值得进一步研究／支持进一步评估／提供研究依据
bounded-conclusion.use_when: 把结论限制到已有证据，并指向可验证的问题。
bounded-conclusion.confusable: supports evaluation不是supports immediate clinical adoption。
bounded-conclusion.safe_example: These findings support prospective evaluation of [hypothesis].
bounded-conclusion.unsafe_example: These findings establish a new standard of care.
bounded-conclusion.boundary: 阴性主要终点与探索性分析仍需明确保留。

figure-narrative.zh: 图表叙事：研究对象→比较→观察→边界
figure-narrative.use_when: 让每段与实际图表和分析集合对应。
figure-narrative.confusable: 图题可以概括观察，不能用推断机制替代图中测量。
figure-narrative.unsafe_example: The figure proves a mechanism not tested in the study.
figure-narrative.boundary: 参考论文提供组织方法，不授权补造本研究图表。

clonal-hematopoiesis.zh: 克隆性造血／造血来源变异
clonal-hematopoiesis.use_when: 描述血浆变异来源判定及实际采用的配对白细胞分析。
clonal-hematopoiesis.confusable: 血浆检出不等于肿瘤来源；白细胞变异也不是自动排除所有肿瘤变异。
clonal-hematopoiesis.safe_example: [Variants] were also detected in matched leukocyte DNA, consistent with a hematopoietic origin.
clonal-hematopoiesis.unsafe_example: Every plasma variant represented tumor-derived ctDNA.
clonal-hematopoiesis.boundary: 没有配对或来源证据时用可能来源，不能补造检测。

dose-dependence.zh: 剂量依赖／浓度依赖／剂量反应
dose-dependence.use_when: 在实际剂量或浓度系列中说明读出变化。
dose-dependence.confusable: 体外浓度不等于体内给药剂量；两点差异不自动证明完整单调曲线。
dose-dependence.safe_example: [Readout] decreased with increasing [drug] concentrations over [tested range].
dose-dependence.unsafe_example: One treated group proved a dose-dependent response.
dose-dependence.boundary: 保留范围、时点、模型和非单调现象，不由模板补出趋势。

enrichment-comparison.zh: 富集于／富集分析／过度代表
enrichment-comparison.use_when: 指明富集对象、参照集合及检验或评分方法。
enrichment-comparison.confusable: 基因集富集不等于通路生化激活；频率富集不等于绝对数量增加。
enrichment-comparison.safe_example: [Gene set] was enriched in [group] relative to [reference] ([reported statistic]).
enrichment-comparison.unsafe_example: Enrichment proved pathway activation and drug sensitivity.
enrichment-comparison.boundary: 只有实际报告时填写NES、OR、q值；不同富集方法的量不可互换。

differential-expression.zh: 差异表达／对数倍数变化
differential-expression.use_when: 写清比较方向、特征、统计单位、筛选阈值与多重校正。
differential-expression.confusable: RNA差异不等于蛋白差异；差异表达不等于功能依赖。
differential-expression.safe_example: [Gene] expression was higher in [group] than in [reference] (log2 fold change, [value]; adjusted P, [value]).
differential-expression.unsafe_example: Differential RNA expression confirmed protein activation.
differential-expression.boundary: 未提供估计和校正时保留缺项，不编数字或算法。

cell-state-lineage.zh: 细胞状态／推断轨迹／拟时序
cell-state-lineage.use_when: 描述状态分布及计算推断的连续变化。
cell-state-lineage.confusable: 拟时序不是实际时间或谱系追踪；簇标签不必等于稳定细胞类型。
cell-state-lineage.safe_example: Trajectory analysis placed [states] along an inferred continuum.
cell-state-lineage.unsafe_example: Pseudotime proved that each cell differentiated into the next cluster.
cell-state-lineage.boundary: 谱系与因果演变需要相应证据；保留患者层级。

spatial-proximity.zh: 最近邻距离／空间邻近／共定位
spatial-proximity.use_when: 按图像或空间测量说明细胞对、区域、距离或共定位定义。
spatial-proximity.confusable: 这些指标相关但不相同；邻近不等于物理接触或配体受体通讯。
spatial-proximity.safe_example: The nearest-neighbor distance between [cell types] was [comparison] in [regions].
spatial-proximity.boundary: 区域和细胞嵌套于患者；不要把区域数当患者数。

protein-abundance-activity.zh: 蛋白丰度／蛋白表达／磷酸化
protein-abundance-activity.use_when: 说明实际检测的总蛋白、修饰位点、标准化方式及平台。
protein-abundance-activity.confusable: 总量不是酶活性；单个位点信号也不自动代表整个通路。
protein-abundance-activity.safe_example: [Assay] showed [direction] in [measured protein or phosphosite] relative to [control].
protein-abundance-activity.unsafe_example: Higher total protein proved greater enzymatic activity.
protein-abundance-activity.boundary: 只有直接活性读出或充分验证才作活性结论。

cross-omics-concordance.zh: 跨组学一致性／多组学整合
cross-omics-concordance.use_when: 说明是否配对样本及各模态测量与整合方法。
cross-omics-concordance.confusable: 不同队列方向一致不等于同一患者多组学配对；一致性不是因果。
cross-omics-concordance.safe_example: [Pattern] was concordant across [specified datasets], which were [paired/unpaired].
cross-omics-concordance.unsafe_example: Unpaired datasets established patient-level RNA–protein coupling.
cross-omics-concordance.boundary: 不能把空间蛋白、bulk RNA、其他瘤种scRNA合成同一队列。

feature-selection-leakage.zh: 特征选择／留出评估／数据泄漏
feature-selection-leakage.use_when: 描述训练、调参、特征选择和测试的真实隔离方式。
feature-selection-leakage.confusable: 在全部样本筛特征后拆分不是真正无泄漏测试。
feature-selection-leakage.safe_example: [Features/model] were selected in [training set] and evaluated in [held-out set].
feature-selection-leakage.unsafe_example: Selecting predictors on all data preserved independent test performance.
feature-selection-leakage.boundary: 不知道步骤顺序时发出查询，不声称已避免泄漏。

batch-adjustment.zh: 批次校正／批次效应调整
batch-adjustment.use_when: 说明真实方法和保留生物差异的评估。
batch-adjustment.confusable: 整合后视觉混合不证明批次偏倚完全消失。
batch-adjustment.safe_example: [Method] was used to account for [recorded batch variable].
batch-adjustment.unsafe_example: Batch correction eliminated all technical and biological confounding.
batch-adjustment.boundary: 不可凭常见流程补写Harmony、ComBat或其他方法。

rescue-extent.use_when: 说明回补对象、对照以及部分或完全恢复的实际读出。
rescue-extent.confusable: 部分恢复不等于完全逆转；过表达回补不等于内源生理条件。
rescue-extent.safe_example: Re-expression of [gene] partially restored [readout] in [perturbed model].
rescue-extent.unsafe_example: A partial rescue proved the sole mechanism in patients.
rescue-extent.boundary: 读出、模型和恢复程度必须由实际实验支撑。

target-engagement.zh: 靶点结合或作用证据／靶点占有率
target-engagement.use_when: 报告具体药效学检测、时点和实际测量指标。
target-engagement.confusable: engagement、occupancy和下游调控并非同一个量；暴露不是疗效。
target-engagement.safe_example: [Assay] provided evidence of target engagement at [exposure/time].
target-engagement.unsafe_example: Target engagement established a survival benefit.
target-engagement.boundary: 只有实际测量占有率时用occupancy及百分数。

combination-interaction.zh: 联合用药相互作用／协同
combination-interaction.use_when: 说明比较基线、评分框架、符号约定和浓度范围。
combination-interaction.confusable: 优于单药不自动等于协同；不同评分的正负号不可套用。
combination-interaction.safe_example: The combination showed [interaction] under [specified model and sign convention].
combination-interaction.unsafe_example: A smaller tumor with combination therapy alone proved pharmacologic synergy.
combination-interaction.boundary: 查阅来源定义；PMID37289191的负delta-area方向不可倒置。

duration-of-response.zh: 缓解持续时间／持续缓解
duration-of-response.use_when: 在缓解者中说明起点、事件、删失和随访成熟度。
duration-of-response.confusable: DOR不是全体患者PFS；观察到仍缓解不等于无限持续。
duration-of-response.safe_example: Among responders, median duration of response was [estimate] at [cutoff].
duration-of-response.unsafe_example: Responder-only duration established longer PFS in all enrolled patients.
duration-of-response.boundary: 未达到中位数时按实际结果写not reached，不杜撰数值。

multiple-testing-fdr.zh: 错误发现率／多重检验校正P值／q值
multiple-testing-fdr.use_when: 保留实际校正方法、检验集合、阈值和统计量名称。
multiple-testing-fdr.confusable: 原始P值不是q值；FDR阈值不是单个发现为假的后验概率。
multiple-testing-fdr.safe_example: [Features] met the prespecified [actual threshold] after [reported correction].
multiple-testing-fdr.unsafe_example: A q value of 0.05 means this specific hypothesis has a 5% probability of being false.
multiple-testing-fdr.boundary: 没有预设或校正资料时不可补写prespecified或FDR。

paired-longitudinal.use_when: 锁定同一患者时点、样本对数、缺失和实际模型。
paired-longitudinal.confusable: 基线与治疗后组数相同不证明配对；横断面不能写成个体变化。
paired-longitudinal.safe_example: In [n] paired samples, [readout] changed from baseline to [time point].
paired-longitudinal.unsafe_example: Unmatched cross-sectional groups demonstrated within-patient evolution.
paired-longitudinal.boundary: 不要自动添加配对检验、混合模型或时间因果关系。

orthogonal-assay.use_when: 用另一测量原理或独立证据检查同一明确观察。
orthogonal-assay.confusable: 换算法分析同一数据不是独立实验；相互印证不等于证实机制。
orthogonal-assay.safe_example: The [specific observation] was corroborated using [actual second assay].
orthogonal-assay.unsafe_example: Two analyses of the same data proved clinical validity.
orthogonal-assay.boundary: 说清第二证据测量什么及与第一证据的对应关系。

study-gap-transition.zh: 尚不明确／研究空白／研究问题过渡
study-gap-transition.use_when: 连接已引用证据与本研究实际问题，而不是堆砌新颖性修饰。
study-gap-transition.confusable: 未在自己的库找到不等于全球尚无人研究。
study-gap-transition.safe_example: Whether [specified relationship] holds in [population] remains unclear.
study-gap-transition.unsafe_example: No study has ever examined this question because none was retrieved locally.
study-gap-transition.boundary: 空白和首次性主张需要检索支撑；翻译时不新增这些主张。

informative-inconclusive-result.zh: 未显著但仍有特定信息价值／统计学尚无定论
informative-inconclusive-result.use_when: 效应量和区间已知，需说明区间仍容许或已经排除哪些重要效应，以及该信息可支持何种有限用途。
informative-inconclusive-result.confusable: 有信息价值不等于结果阳性、效应已证实或临床获益已建立。
informative-inconclusive-result.safe_example: The estimate did not demonstrate benefit, but the confidence interval defined the range of effects that remained plausible.
informative-inconclusive-result.unsafe_example: Although P exceeded 0.05, the benefit was still clinically meaningful.
informative-inconclusive-result.boundary: 必须给出具体依据，如预设阈值、区间范围、生物学一致性或后续研究用途；单凭方向符合预期或P值接近0.05不够。

match_terms: statistical significance could not be determined
statistical-significance-undetermined.zh: 统计学意义未报告／无法判断
statistical-significance-undetermined.use_when: 只有描述性方向或数值，但没有足以判断推断状态的效应量、区间、P值或检验结果。
statistical-significance-undetermined.confusable: 统计学意义无法判断不等于已经检验但未显著。
statistical-significance-undetermined.safe_example: The observed difference was descriptive; statistical significance could not be determined from the reported data.
statistical-significance-undetermined.unsafe_example: The difference was nonsignificant because no P value was reported.
statistical-significance-undetermined.boundary: 不得补造效应量、区间或P值，也不得据缺失信息声称结果显著、未显著或有临床意义。

recheck-exome-control.zh: 全外显子测序；配对正常/胚系对照
collocations: variants detected in the assayed regions
recheck-exome-control.use_when: 写清测序覆盖、正常对照来源及胚系确认方式。
recheck-exome-control.confusable: 肿瘤单独测序的疑似胚系变异不是配对正常样本确认的胚系变异。
recheck-exome-control.safe_example: Variants were classified using [sequencing assay] and [available matched-normal evidence].
recheck-exome-control.unsafe_example: Tumor-only WES confirmed every inherited variant.
recheck-exome-control.boundary: WES是基因组学；本词条不能替用户补充未做的正常对照。

recheck-phospho-immunoblot.use_when: 区分基线水平、处理后变化、总蛋白和磷酸化蛋白；注明比较方向。
recheck-phospho-immunoblot.confusable: 处理后诱导更强不等于基线更高，也不等于细胞毒性更强。
recheck-phospho-immunoblot.safe_example: Treatment produced greater relative induction of [phosphorylation readout], without a corresponding increase in [cytotoxic endpoint].
recheck-phospho-immunoblot.unsafe_example: Stronger STING phosphorylation proved universal chemotherapy sensitization.
recheck-phospho-immunoblot.boundary: 靶向蛋白实验不是全局蛋白组；只能描述实际检测的蛋白和条件。

recheck-conditional-proportion.use_when: 先确认是在蛋白缺失组内统计变异类型，还是在某变异类型内统计蛋白缺失。
recheck-conditional-proportion.confusable: P(变异类别|蛋白缺失)不等于P(蛋白缺失|变异类别)。
recheck-conditional-proportion.safe_example: Among [protein-loss tumors], [fraction] carried [variant class]; this is not the class-specific probability of protein loss.
recheck-conditional-proportion.unsafe_example: Most loss-positive tumors were truncating, so most truncating tumors had protein loss.
recheck-conditional-proportion.boundary: 不得反转柱图分母；原文摘要和图注不一致时保留冲突。

recheck-mutation-versus-loss.zh: 突变、等位基因状态与功能缺失分层
recheck-mutation-versus-loss.use_when: 分别写变异致病性、拷贝数、等位基因状态、RNA及蛋白证据。
recheck-mutation-versus-loss.confusable: 单等位缺失不是完全失活；突变加拷贝缺失不自动证明已定相的双等位失活。
recheck-mutation-versus-loss.safe_example: [Alteration class] was associated with lower [protein measure], but complete functional loss was not established.
recheck-mutation-versus-loss.unsafe_example: Any STK11 variant proves biallelic LKB1 loss.
recheck-mutation-versus-loss.boundary: MTAP的GCN<0.6判据不能迁移成STK11阈值。

recheck-deletion-extent.zh: 缺失范围：整基因与部分外显子
collocations: deletion of one or more exons
recheck-deletion-extent.use_when: 先说明本文complete/partial指缺失范围还是功能程度。
recheck-deletion-extent.confusable: MTAP文章中两类均按纯合缺失定义，不能译成双等位与单等位缺失。
recheck-deletion-extent.safe_example: Both categories met the homozygous-loss criterion; they differed in the extent of exon coverage.
recheck-deletion-extent.unsafe_example: Partial MTAP loss means monoallelic deletion.
recheck-deletion-extent.boundary: 基因特异操作性定义必须保留。

recheck-union-intersection.zh: 任一基因改变的并集；双突变交集
collocations: mutant irrespective of the other gene
recheck-union-intersection.use_when: 明确是否含单突变、双突变及其归组优先级。
recheck-union-intersection.confusable: STK11 and/or KEAP1不是仅STK11/KEAP1双突变；STK11-mutant也不等于STK11-only。
recheck-union-intersection.safe_example: The union included tumors with either alteration alone or both alterations.
recheck-union-intersection.unsafe_example: All patients in the either-gene subgroup had both mutations.
recheck-union-intersection.boundary: 不能用合并亚组结果替代单基因独立效应。

recheck-assay-negative.zh: 未检出、未检测与统计互斥
recheck-assay-negative.use_when: 报告检测该基因的真实分母及检验方法。
recheck-assay-negative.confusable: 面板未覆盖不是野生型；小样本零共现不是普遍互斥。
recheck-assay-negative.safe_example: No [alteration] was observed in the assayed subgroup; limited coverage precluded a strong exclusivity claim.
recheck-assay-negative.unsafe_example: No recorded STK11 mutation proves biological incompatibility with Q61L.
recheck-assay-negative.boundary: Q61文章STK11仅31例有覆盖，不能以全部365例为分母。

recheck-endpoint-clock.zh: 终点起算时点与延迟进入风险集
recheck-endpoint-clock.use_when: 分别定义OS、PFS及风险集进入时点；比较时保留治疗线别。
recheck-endpoint-clock.confusable: 从诊断开始的OS不能当作从用药开始的OS；左截断不等于右删失。
recheck-endpoint-clock.safe_example: OS was measured from [diagnosis], whereas PFS began at [treatment initiation].
recheck-endpoint-clock.unsafe_example: Different index dates represent the same survival estimand.
recheck-endpoint-clock.boundary: 不能因同称OS就直接合并治疗方案优劣。

recheck-model-versus-test.zh: 调整后效应量与未调整检验分开报告
recheck-model-versus-test.use_when: 核对HR及P值是否来自同一个模型，注明真实协变量。
recheck-model-versus-test.confusable: 图中调整后HR旁边的log-rank P不是调整后Cox P；非分层不等于多变量调整。
recheck-model-versus-test.safe_example: The adjusted HR was [estimate]; the displayed P value was from the log-rank comparison.
recheck-model-versus-test.unsafe_example: Every P value next to an adjusted HR was adjusted for all co-mutations.
recheck-model-versus-test.boundary: 主文只转述补充模型时不能声称已核对其全部参数。

recheck-inconsistent-interval.zh: 效应量与区间内部一致性核对
collocations: the reported interval was internally inconsistent
recheck-inconsistent-interval.use_when: 先核对端点、比较方向、点估计是否落在区间内及正文图表一致性。
recheck-inconsistent-interval.confusable: 图表与正文冲突不能靠猜测选一个；HR方向颠倒也不能只改数字。
recheck-inconsistent-interval.safe_example: The source reports conflicting intervals; the disputed interval is withheld pending clarification.
recheck-inconsistent-interval.unsafe_example: The HR was outside its CI, so we silently corrected the CI.
recheck-inconsistent-interval.boundary: 隔离问题数字，不将整个文章的安全术语误判为不可用。

recheck-null-versus-equivalent.zh: 未达显著差异，不等于相同或等效
collocations: no statistically significant difference was detected
recheck-null-versus-equivalent.use_when: 保留效应量和区间，并说明是否真正设计了等效性检验。
recheck-null-versus-equivalent.confusable: 未拒绝零假设不证明零效应；一个终点显著不自动使其他终点显著。
recheck-null-versus-equivalent.safe_example: No statistically significant difference in [endpoint] was detected; equivalence was not tested.
recheck-null-versus-equivalent.boundary: 禁止用unchanged替换未达显著；稀少亚组尤其需要精度提示。

recheck-median-ci-nr.zh: 中位数未达到与置信区间上限未估出
collocations: the upper confidence limit was not estimable
recheck-median-ci-nr.use_when: 确认NR标记对应哪个终点以及中位数还是区间端点。
recheck-median-ci-nr.confusable: PFS区间上限NR不是PFS中位数NR；OS未达到不能套到PFS。
recheck-median-ci-nr.safe_example: Median [endpoint] was [value], with an upper confidence limit that was not estimable.
recheck-median-ci-nr.unsafe_example: A missing upper CI means that median PFS was not reached.
recheck-median-ci-nr.boundary: 表头、曲线横轴、图注须共同核对。

recheck-cluster-genotype.zh: 表达亚型与突变归组不是同一标签
recheck-cluster-genotype.use_when: 分别给出分型算法、训练/验证集和基因型分配规则。
recheck-cluster-genotype.confusable: KL表达群可以没有检测到STK11突变；KLm/KPLm是另一种分组。
recheck-cluster-genotype.safe_example: The expression-defined subgroup was enriched for [alteration], but membership was not determined solely by mutation status.
recheck-cluster-genotype.unsafe_example: Every tumor in the KL expression cluster was STK11-mutant.
recheck-cluster-genotype.boundary: 共聚类或富集不证明因果驱动。

recheck-locus-attribution.zh: 区域共缺失与单基因归因
recheck-locus-attribution.use_when: 呈现共缺失范围、联合基因型及不一致组样本量。
recheck-locus-attribution.confusable: 相关邻近基因不能靠多变量模型自动分离因果贡献。
recheck-locus-attribution.safe_example: Tight linkage and sparse discordant groups limited attribution to an individual gene.
recheck-locus-attribution.unsafe_example: Co-deletion proves each neighboring gene independently causes the outcome.
recheck-locus-attribution.boundary: 19p和9p21.3只作结构类比，不互借生物学机制。

recheck-separate-omics-cohorts.zh: 跨组学、临床队列的证据衔接
recheck-separate-omics-cohorts.use_when: 每次转入新数据集时重报来源、N和检测平台。
recheck-separate-omics-cohorts.confusable: 不同患者队列中方向一致不是同一患者的中介链。
recheck-separate-omics-cohorts.safe_example: In [clinical cohort], loss was associated with outcome. In a separate [RNA/protein dataset], loss was associated with lower expression; mediation was not tested.
recheck-separate-omics-cohorts.unsafe_example: TCGA expression proved mediation of outcomes in every DFCI patient.
recheck-separate-omics-cohorts.boundary: 段落合成必须保留队列转换，不能为流畅而删去。

recheck-mouse-human-omics.zh: 小鼠单细胞实测与人群bulk反卷积
collocations: immune composition inferred from bulk RNA
recheck-mouse-human-omics.use_when: 先给物种、样本单位、测序方式，再讲细胞类型或状态。
recheck-mouse-human-omics.confusable: 人群反卷积不是人单细胞实测；单细胞来源克隆也不等于单细胞组学。
recheck-mouse-human-omics.safe_example: Mouse scRNA-seq characterized cell states, whereas human immune composition was inferred from bulk profiles.
recheck-mouse-human-omics.unsafe_example: Human single-cell sequencing validated the result when only bulk RNA was analyzed.
recheck-mouse-human-omics.boundary: 不把细胞数当独立动物重复数。

recheck-imaging-assay.use_when: 按真实实验命名，注明组织细胞密度、蛋白量或磷酸化读出。
recheck-imaging-assay.confusable: CD8单标IHC不是mIF；mIF不是空间转录组；RPPA不是全局质谱蛋白组。
recheck-imaging-assay.safe_example: CD8 density was assessed by [single-marker IHC], not multiplex or transcriptome-wide profiling.
recheck-imaging-assay.unsafe_example: A CD8 IHC comparison established spatial multi-omics.

recheck-ratio-denominator.zh: 相对保留、比例富集与绝对数量
collocations: as a fraction of CD45-positive cells
recheck-ratio-denominator.use_when: 说明分母是活细胞、CD45细胞、非肿瘤细胞还是组织面积。
recheck-ratio-denominator.confusable: 比值升高可能由分母减少造成，不能自动写成分子细胞绝对扩增。
recheck-ratio-denominator.safe_example: The ratio increased alongside depletion of [denominator population]; absolute expansion was not established.
recheck-ratio-denominator.unsafe_example: A higher TH1/CD8 ratio proves all CD4 cells expanded.
recheck-ratio-denominator.boundary: 保留模型及测量时点差异；Treg未减少不能写成被清除。

recheck-nested-replication.zh: 实验单位、技术复孔与嵌套样本
recheck-nested-replication.use_when: 报告独立动物/培养实验N、每个单位内技术测量及分层重抽样。
recheck-nested-replication.confusable: 数千细胞或肿瘤条码不是数千独立动物；三复孔不等于三次独立实验。
recheck-nested-replication.safe_example: Uncertainty was estimated by resampling mice and then tumors within mice.
recheck-nested-replication.unsafe_example: Every cell or barcode constituted an independent biological replicate.
recheck-nested-replication.boundary: 只有实际采用的重抽样层级才能写入Methods。

recheck-perturbation-direction.zh: 回补、敲低与方向特异的实验解释
recheck-perturbation-direction.use_when: 分别检查基因状态、对照方向、药物及实验条件。
recheck-perturbation-direction.confusable: 回补与敲低的效应方向不能合成同一句升高；不同药物不能概括为全类显著。
recheck-perturbation-direction.safe_example: [Perturbation] altered sensitivity to [compound] in [model]; the direction and exceptions were reported separately.
recheck-perturbation-direction.unsafe_example: Restoration and knockdown both increased IC50 in all models.
recheck-perturbation-direction.boundary: CD2015正文与Fig7D冲突保留，以具体图组表述并警示。

recheck-acquired-selected.zh: 选择性配对样本中的新检出事件
collocations: detected at progression in paired samples
recheck-acquired-selected.use_when: 列出初始人群、重复活检、面板覆盖和配对可评价的逐层分母。
recheck-acquired-selected.confusable: 进展时新检出不直接证明新发生、治疗诱导或耐药因果。
recheck-acquired-selected.safe_example: The alteration was newly detected in [number] of [assay-covered paired cases], warranting functional follow-up.
recheck-acquired-selected.unsafe_example: Two selected progression biopsies proved a universal acquired-resistance mechanism.
recheck-acquired-selected.boundary: 不能将配对亚集频率套到全队列。

recheck-source-conflict-language.zh: 原文不一致的透明陈述
collocations: the text and figure report different values
recheck-source-conflict-language.use_when: 注明来源版本、正文/图表位置、冲突内容及使用处置。
recheck-source-conflict-language.confusable: 原文冲突不应静默修补；存在冲突也不等于整篇文献无效。
recheck-source-conflict-language.safe_example: The text and figure disagree on [item]; we retain the supported conclusion but withhold the disputed value.
recheck-source-conflict-language.unsafe_example: We selected the more plausible value without documenting the disagreement.
recheck-source-conflict-language.boundary: 更正记录与原始阅读记录并存，不能覆盖历史以制造一致。

recheck-study-rationale.zh: 从知识缺口到有边界的研究目标
recheck-study-rationale.use_when: 说明已有证据能回答什么、尚不能回答什么，再引出本研究实际目标。
recheck-study-rationale.confusable: remainuncertain不是从未有人研究；结构相似不是同一基因机制。
recheck-study-rationale.safe_example: Existing genomic associations do not fully resolve [functional or clinical question], motivating [the analysis actually performed].
recheck-study-rationale.unsafe_example: An MTAP paper establishes the missing STK11 mechanism.
recheck-study-rationale.boundary: 不夸大创新性，不替用户新增未完成分析。

recheck-bounded-clinical-synthesis.zh: 结论层的研究依据与临床效用边界
recheck-bounded-clinical-synthesis.use_when: 综合多层证据后说明尚需何种验证，而不是直接给出患者选择规则。
recheck-bounded-clinical-synthesis.confusable: 模型机制与探索性试验亚组相互支持，仍不等于临床预测标志物已验证。
recheck-bounded-clinical-synthesis.safe_example: These findings support prospective evaluation of [strategy] in [defined context], without establishing a universal treatment-selection rule.
recheck-bounded-clinical-synthesis.unsafe_example: The retrospective association establishes which therapy every STK11 patient must receive.
recheck-bounded-clinical-synthesis.boundary: 仅用于科研写作，不用于个体诊疗决策。

atm-truncating-estimate.restriction: Do not reuse the truncating-ATM HR 0.731 / CI 0.899–1.038 trio. KRAS-conditioned co-mutation and drug-specific experimental effects must remain separate from pooled associations.

smarca4-classes.restriction: SMARCA4 variant class, protein loss and STK11 co-occurrence are distinct. Retrospective ICI associations do not prove predictive benefit.

atm-null-context.restriction: Preserve overall null ICI findings and exploratory subgroup limits; pathogenicity, LOH and protein loss are not interchangeable.

g12v-denominators.restriction: Separate 636-patient molecular and 151-patient advanced-treatment cohorts; no STK11-specific causal or predictive treatment claim.

q61-conditioning.restriction: Q61H/Q61L assay coverage differs; STK11 was assayed in only31 patients. Zero observed STK11 in assayed Q61L is not universal mutual exclusivity. No reliable direct H-versus-L treatment-effect comparison.

ampratio-transfer.restriction: NSCLC STK11/EGFR amplification context is not STK11 treatment validation; HER2 outcome cohorts are other cancers. Do not transfer amplification cutoffs to STK11 deletion.

erbb2-adjustment.restriction: Adjusted ECD-versus-TKD PFS P=0.06 and CI includes 1; do not call it significant. Supplied PDF is pre-proof, not version of record.

durvalumab-figure4.restriction: Results prose and Figure 4 disagree on STK11/CDKN2A HR assignment. Figure4 is physical PDF p33. Physical p14 line282 says OS but Table2 physical p29 is a PFS model; do not transfer that OS label. Disclose conflicts for exact estimates. No non-durvalumab comparator. Supplied PDF is pre-proof.

stk11-copy-loss.restriction: Separate monoallelic deletion, biallelic inactivation, TCGA expression and treatment cohorts; preserve 19p co-deletion and ICI-alone heterogeneity.

mtap-not-stk11.restriction: Structural analogue only: no STK11/LKB1 analysis in supplied main text. MTAP copy number <0.6 is not an STK11 threshold.

cd2015-figure7.restriction: Expression clusters differ from mutation groups. p11 prose and Fig7D conflict on knockdown IC50 direction; reopen panel before a directional drug-sensitivity claim.

cd2018-source-conflict.restriction: Preserve response denominators, LKB1 protein versus mutation, small comparator uncertainty and unresolved source confidence-interval discrepancy. Reopen the article for exact estimates.

nature-union-contrast.restriction: STK11 and/or KEAP1 is a union, not double mutation. TDCT-versus-CT and TDCT-versus-DCT differ; the latter OS CI includes 1. Human bulk inference differs from mouse scRNA. PD-L1 denominator and other source conflicts remain bounded.

lpa-proteomics-conflict.restriction: Methods disagree on label-free versus TMT protein quantification; do not select either as resolved. CellChat/c4 LPA secretion is inferred, not directly measured. Internal split is not external validation.

genomics2025-39804166.restriction: Shorter STK11-mutant survival does not imply lower ORR: both groups45%. NRF2/OS in KEAP1WT is nonsignificant. Figure4A drug label differs from caption. Clinical associations are not predictive interactions; combinations are preclinical.

genomics2025-39932457.restriction: Patient prevalence and all-call/somatic-call CH proportions have different denominators. Figure1 classification direction and Figure2C mean/median labels conflict with prose. Do not implement the algorithm from this source alone.

genomics2025-40704901.restriction: Thoracic NUT carcinoma is not interchangeable with all NSCLC. Assay sensitivity requires modality-specific coverage denominators; no significant survival difference by detection modality. BRD4 exon and calendar labels differ across source locations.

genomics2025-40388547.restriction: NCI-MATCH concordance concerns shared genes and actionable entry alterations, not entire profiles. Table2 sarcoma CI does not contain its estimate. Negative plasma does not exclude tissue-defined response.

genomics2025-39437011.restriction: Observational treatment interaction is not randomized predictive validation. Low-volume PFS P values and FDR notation conflict within source. Olink targeted proteins are not mass-spectrometry whole-proteome data.

genomics2025-39887260.restriction: RET-positive-only sample selection cannot estimate clinical specificity. Abstract QC denominators conflict with Results; rescue analyses are unblinded/post hoc and not primary assay sensitivity.

genomics2025-40310449.restriction: VISION tissue/liquid groups overlap. Between-biopsy efficacy comparisons are descriptive without formal P values. Any-variant ctDNA detectability differs from METex14 positivity; tumor burden confounds comparisons.

genomics2025-39853318.restriction: Updated same261-patient MRD cohort is not external validation. Negative MRD is not proof of cure or absence of adjuvant benefit. Figure3C HR/CI conflict and invalid prose P value must not be reused.

genomics2025-40261185.restriction: ctMoniTR landmark/internal test split is not external validation or trial-level surrogate validation. Preserve persistent-versus-clearance reference direction and endpoint-specific denominators. Table1 totals differ from subgroup sums.

genomics2025-40465842.restriction: Lung-MAP Figure6 caption CI lower bound conflicts with plot/Results; Figure2 color labels conflict. High tumor fraction improves some detection while marking poorer prognosis, not treatment prediction. CNA sensitivity remains limited.

genomics2025-40047548.restriction: Quantified ADC target abundance is not demonstrated ADC efficacy. Unknown EGFR status is not wild type. Analytical LOD/LOQ is not a clinical response cutoff; protein calibration is targeted, not discovery proteomics.

genomics2025-39836411.restriction: RAS-RAF PLA is pan-RAS proximity, not KRASG12C-specific binding. Small treated-only cohort and optimized cutoff do not validate treatment selection. Table1 sex/year percentages conflict with counts; external co-mutation cohort is not this study.

genomics2025-39620930.restriction: DIAMOND all-model methylation validation sensitivity41% at99%specificity differs from combined91% at93%. Cancer-specific experts are not tissue-origin classifiers. Lung validation has8 metastatic cases; no early-lung screening validation.

reading-20260923-41961582.restriction: Keep51/41 efficacy,95 pooled safety and66 reduced-dose safety distinct. Abstract lower CI3.1 conflicts with31.1 inResults/Table2. No randomized comparative benefit; substantial toxicity.

reading-20260923-40378060.restriction: Separate67treated/63response-evaluable and prior-ICI strata. Table4 notes unconfirmed partial responses; prose ORR CI is inconsistent. No validated HVEM predictive effect.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34045189-1.restriction: 16gene expression, sequence mutation and copy loss jointly define function-deficient class; never relabel all classifier-positive tumors STK11-mutant.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34045189-2.restriction: Fig1B cell-line groups sum99, Methods/Results state98; preserve unresolved denominator, do not silently reconcile.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34045189-3.restriction: No significant global-surrogate methylation change after LKB1 perturbation and inconsistent DNMT1 response; patient association does not prove a completed LKB1→SAM-e→DNA methylation mechanism.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34045189-4.restriction: Metabolomics33 tumors including9 functional-loss; relative spectral intensities are not absolute concentrations or measured metabolic flux.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34045189-5.restriction: FOXA motif enrichment is not direct binding measurement in these tumors; ENCODE controls are not matched epithelium. FOXA2 RNA P.21 is nonsignificant despite protein/localization findings.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34045189-6.restriction: Fig3D legend mentionsTLR2 but graphic shows CXCL8/IRF3/IRF7 only; do not claim visually verifiedTLR2 result.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34045189-7.restriction: Azacytidine cell-model findings and supplement-only cisplatin description do not establish patient immunotherapy response or clinical biomarker utility.

supplement-ccr-20261002-boundary-3326461.restriction: Joint-loss model dependency and treatment-agnostic prognosis, not universal STK11 therapy prediction. Clinical/TMA counts conflict; immune-deficient xenografts cannot establish antitumor immunity; no clinical safety/efficacy.

supplement-ccr-20261002-33264619-1.restriction: Main text/Venn KRAS358 and joint123 differ from TableS5 KRAS359 and joint124; do not silently harmonize one-patient differences.

supplement-ccr-20261002-33264619-2.restriction: Clinical Figure1 table reports median OS though caption says average; exact numerical HRs not printed. Mouse survival is time to prespecified tumor-size endpoint, not natural death or clinical OS.

supplement-ccr-20261002-33264619-3.restriction: CCF292 samples derive from276patients; colocated19p loss/clonality do not establish temporal ordering of mutations.

supplement-ccr-20261002-33264619-4.restriction: TMA counts include scored/duplicate cores and inconsistent119 vs60+58 source descriptions; no resolved unique patient denominator. Do not report staining-core fractions as patient prevalence.

supplement-ccr-20261002-33264619-5.restriction: Caption/Methods three-cell-line wording differs from principal H358/H292 RNAseq models with three clones each; do not infer three distinct backgrounds.

supplement-ccr-20261002-33264619-6.restriction: KEAP1 restoration inhibits growth while LKB1 restoration does not measurably reduce tested A549/H460 growth; retain this negative result without equivalence claims.

supplement-ccr-20261002-33264619-7.restriction: AKR pharmacological/genetic effects limited and AKR family absent from significant screen hits; viability changes are not ferroptosis-specific because apoptosis also observed. Do not claim established AKR clinical therapy.

supplement-ccr-20261002-33264619-8.restriction: No formal combination-index model establishes universal synergy; report measured combination effects and retain negative WT xenograft comparison. No patient efficacy/safety.

supplement-ccr-20261002-33264619-9.restriction: Focused1463gene screen is not whole-genome; original cell bulk RNA is not patient multiomics. Immune-deficient xenograft findings do not demonstrate immune-competent antitumor immunity.

supplement-ccr-20261002-boundary-3434153.restriction: Stage-dependent epigenetic/metastatic-state evidence in defined models, with small human public-data support. Human STK11 enrichment FDR=.088; no clinical prediction/therapy validation. Preserve source conflicts and liver P=.055. Notes intentionally contain no executable experimental procedures.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34341533-1.restriction: Fig1b caption claims six chromatin genes FDR<.01, but displayed Suz12=.0354, Trim28=.0571, Smarce1=.0804. Describe six top20 chromatin-related genes, not six .01/.05-significant hits.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34341533-2.restriction: Human TCGA ATAC n21 (13/8). STK11 enrichment FDR=.088 is relative top rank, not q<.05. Methods references TCGA230 background binomial enrichment; do not invent direct two-group Fisher comparison.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34341533-3.restriction: Cluster12 n112 in p6 Results versus116 in ED9 caption, which omits cluster10; ED9d caption comparison1-11 versus plotted6-11. Do not invent definitive fraction or comparison set.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34341533-4.restriction: Specific allograft paragraph says randomized; general statistics says experiments not randomized. Not formally blinded; no statistical sample-size determination. Do not assert global randomized/blinded design.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34341533-5.restriction: Fig2c TEAD exact P9e-6 differs from four-star P<1e-6 definition. Fig2b caption duplicates x-axis; actual human x/mouse y. Fig5d heatmap points to ED7f rather than displayed ED10f; other ED10 in-text crossreferences are unreliable. Preserve locators and visible content.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34341533-6.restriction: Liver endpoint n9/n8 P=.055 is not significant at .05; retain local-tumor-size null result in Fig6f. No clinical ORR/OS or universally faster tumor growth follows.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34341533-7.restriction: scATAC metastatic-like subset is not proven metastasis ancestor by lineage tracing; nuclei not independent tumors. cluster12 predominantly derives from two tumors of one mouse. Motif/footprint not unique direct SOX17-binding proof.

supplement-ccr-20261002-34341533-8.restriction: Kras/Trp53 mouse context and immunodeficient transplant endpoints do not establish immune evasion or ICI resistance. Unknown second signal remains. supplement-ccr-20261002-34341533-9.restriction: Embedded ED1-10 fully read, but external Supplementary Information/Tables1-6/Source Data/raw datasets not supplied/read. GSE167381 is a locator, not a claim of raw-data verification.

ccr-20261007-34074656-source-boundaries.restriction: CDKN2A associations are tumor-specific; replicated urothelial findings must not be transferred to NSCLC or STK11. Retrospective treated-cohort and separate negative comparator findings do not establish predictive interaction. Preserve DNA variant/copy-loss definitions and different TCGA135/OS131/PFS132 denominators. Figure4C IC0/IC2+ labels conflict with the prose totals/direction; hold category-specific rates. Figure2 risk-row colors, selected P values, response OR coding, platinum HR/CI and the printed treatment-frequency anomaly also require the reading-note warnings; do not silently correct or transfer them.

ccr-20261007-33272981-source-boundaries.restriction: DNA rearrangement is not necessarily an expressed oncogenic RET fusion:105/151 composite-positive cases were not RNA-confirmed. DNA46/46 sensitivity uses the selectively co-tested4525 set; FISH/IHC use different enriched denominators and reference definitions. IHC validation is internal, not external. Partner-dependent misses, especially NCOA4, limit transfer. Plasma5/16 includes3RNA-negative SVUS, not a fusion sensitivity estimate;4selected treated responders are not validated100% population ORR. N/C-terminal fusion architecture is inconsistent in the Introduction and held from language reuse. IHC/FISH are not proteomics or transcriptome-wide assays.

ccr-20261007-35802677-source-boundaries.restriction: Methylation-derived immune fractions and epigenetic age are inferred from methylation, not RNA/single-cell measurements. Age-related OS and subgroup1-versus2-5 OS comparisons are nonsignificant. Figure5A P=.0037 conflicts with prose .0007. Recurrence information is available for56/88; all27 EPIC cases lack recurrence data, and RFS eligibility further differs. Ten ROIs do not mean ten independent patients. STK11 has only exploratory lower DNAm age P=.0476 and no detected immune-composition or subgroup-enrichment difference; no causal or treatment-predictive inference.

ccr-20261007-34921025-source-boundaries.restriction: The new experiments are cell-line assays, not mouse/xenograft experiments or demonstrated patient combination benefit. Membrane expression, colony formation and biochemical damage readouts remain distinct; public RPPA is not IHC H-score. Preserve on/off-TKI counts: narrative28/20 versus paired-IHC26/22 in pp9-10 and Figure4G. Colony duration differs between Methods14days and Figure5caption10days; disclose rather than select silently. Nonsignificant/FDR-ineligible pathway trends are not established enrichment; greater inhibition is not formal synergy.

ccr-20261007-32241817-source-boundaries.restriction: Del-NOTCH treatment interaction differs by endpoint: PFS P=.012 but OS P=.255. Do not claim confirmed OS predictive interaction. Docetaxel del-NOTCH ORR conflicts between p9 prose (9.3%) and Figure5A p10 (5.6%); do not reuse either without disclosing the conflict. Preserve WT PFS P=.279/.297, local94%/95%CI and localOS Fig1/Fig2 estimate conflicts. Several DDR/immune enrichment tests are nonsignificant. Overlapping cohorts are not unique ICI patients, and predicted damage is not proven loss of function. STK11 adjusted associations are not STK11-by-treatment interaction or mechanism.

ccr-20261007-31694835-source-boundaries.restriction: Normal airway overgrowth and malignant identity must be resolved before treating a culture as a tumor model. Initial57/65 culture establishment is not10/65 long-term success; contamination7/12 is not7/65. Nine models contribute23 sequenced samples. Figure5D BGJ398+BKM120 combination index is above1 atED50 but below1 atED75, not uniformly synergistic. Figure4 single-star annotation means P>.05, and p11 short-term MEK wording conflicts with p8/Figure4 long-term experiments. These preclinical findings do not establish prospective patient predictive utility or direct STK11 evidence.

intake-20261018-31548347.restriction: Pathway-mutant union is not a triple-mutant group; clinical matched association and murine deletion causality are separate. TTF is not PFS; source Table2 HR/CI/P inconsistencies must not be reused as verified adjusted estimates. Read the article-specific source alerts before numerical reuse.

intake-20261018-32102950.restriction: Four-gene negative-predictor union is not a four-gene co-mutant genotype or independently validated gene-specific treatment predictor. Endpoint-optimized pTMB cutoff is cohort/assay specific; OS P=.061 and mutation-only comparisons remain nonsignificant. Read the article-specific source alerts before numerical reuse.

intake-20261018-33323401.restriction: STK11/KEAP1-mutant means either-gene union, not confirmed double mutation. Single-arm small subgroup and a 12-month OS landmark signal do not establish overall OS benefit, a randomized treatment interaction or reversal of STK11-mediated resistance. Read the article-specific source alerts before numerical reuse.

intake-20261018-35504291.restriction: Engineered genotype comparisons and external human expression associations are separate. Flow V-beta repertoire and tSNE are not TCR-seq or scRNA-seq. Combination impairs immune function under the tested schedule; combination OS was not evaluated. Read the article-specific source alerts before numerical reuse.

ccr-six-gate-42189883-needs-correction.restriction: Central PFS reuse is blocked: the main PDF leaves cCRT-versus-durvalumab time origin unresolved, does not document a valid HR-estimation model, and does not provide cutoff provenance. Log-rank/Wilcoxon discordance, a correlation-sign conflict and a CCR7/CD45RA phenotype-label conflict must remain explicit. Peripheral immune changes are exploratory treatment-context associations, not causal sequencing or validated prediction of durvalumab benefit.

ccr-six-gate-40499141-needs-correction.restriction: Withhold the conflicted PDX tumor identity, 15-versus18-mg/kg high dose, DB-1419 immunogenic-cell-death claim and unsupported prognostic coexpression statement. Activity and toxicology are preclinical and model-specific; they do not establish human efficacy, human safety, checkpoint-resistance reversal or tumor-agnostic benefit.

ccr-six-gate-42007996-needs-correction.restriction: Preserve the OV-90 n=7-versusn=6 source conflict and the carboplatin dose omissions caused by body-weight loss. In-vivo combinations support additive/co-operative activity, not formal synergy. Small n=3 PDX arms, research IHC and a heterogeneous cross-product dose plot do not establish a selection threshold, pan-tumor efficacy, clinical safety or superior tolerability.

ccr-six-gate-42578969-needs-correction.restriction: The primary result is ORR0% in26 centrally confirmed analyzable patients; do not generalize this to zero activity in every fusion, histology or lung-cancer subgroup. Six-month-PFS upper90% CI conflicts between abstract17.7% and Results16.3%. No treatment-related grade5 event is not the same as no grade5 event:10 all-cause grade5 events occurred on treatment. Two of three PFS-over-six-month cases were nonanalyzable, and descriptive co-alterations do not prove resistance.

ccr-six-gate-41065506-needs-correction.restriction: Use LRP1B alteration rather than functional loss: the definition includes VUS. Preserve n=1569-versus1570 and imputation/analysis-denominator inconsistencies, subclass nulls and model-specific OR/HR estimates. No reported treatment-by-biomarker interaction validates prediction; within-arm significance patterns, unsupplied TMB-low/STK11/KEAP subgroup claims and obsolete-regimen data cannot support chemotherapy omission or current chemo-immunotherapy selection.

ccr-six-gate-41026583-needs-correction.restriction: Mouse PFS lacks a defined event and reported survival-comparison method, and multiple testing is not controlled. Negative primary-cell assays omit relevant neural/testicular cells; two control mice were lost without necropsy, denominators changed and xGvHD occurred across arms. Selected xenograft activity supports preclinical proof of concept only, not human safety, clinical efficacy, a selection threshold or SCLC-wide applicability.
